sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có thể rửa tay ở đâu? is useful when the map, sign, or building layout is not giving you the final answer. It names wash my hands in a compact way, so a local can point, give a landmark, or send you to the right counter.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep it short: Tôi có thể rửa tay ở đâu?. Show your sign, shelf, photo, or the place you are already standing near, then listen for the first useful clue: a point, floor, street, counter, or landmark.

sections.body: Use this when you are already in the general area but need the final direction. It fits hotel, cafe, mall, station, or shop moment, especially when wash my hands can be pointed to on a map, sign, booking, or nearby landmark.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Directions in Vietnam are often answered with pointing plus a few words. That is useful: watch the gesture first, then ask a follow-up if you need the street, floor, or entrance repeated.
